name: RRP Defense Limited
about: RRP Defense Limited engages in the manufacture, operations, repair, renting, and training of drones in India. It offers reflex and thermal sights, border protection systems, and miniature cameras. The company was formerly known as Euro Asia Exports Limited and changed its name to RRP Defense Limited in June 2025. The company was incorporated in 1981 and is based in Navi Mumbai, India.
